fusions.name: Razor Shallows
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of reef 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 25 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it and leaves them [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Staghorn Ambush
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to the target and bites for 13 damage. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, its critical hit chance is 40% higher.

fusions.name: Hidden Lurker
fusions.desc: Sets a trap under the nearest enemy that stays armed for 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 3 tiles sets it off in a blast that deals 18 damage.

fusions.name: Rows That Regrow

riders.text: what is torn out of you grows back
and every row comes round sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
